pokedexEntries.di: It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.

pokedexEntries.prl: It carries a round, egg-shaped rock in its belly pouch and gives the rock to its friends.

pokedexEntries.pt: It likes to carry around a small rock. It may wander around others’ feet and cause them to stumble.

pokedexEntries.hgss: It carefully carries a round, white rock that it thinks is an egg. It’s bothered by how curly its hair looks.

pokedexEntries.bw: It likes to carry around a small rock. It may wander around others’ feet and cause them to stumble.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It likes to carry around a small rock. It may wander around others’ feet and cause them to stumble.

pokedexEntries.x: It carries a round, egg-shaped rock in its belly pouch and gives the rock to its friends.

pokedexEntries.or: It carries a round, egg-shaped rock in its belly pouch and gives the rock to its friends.

pokedexEntries.y: It carefully carries a round, white rock that it thinks is an egg. It’s bothered by how curly its hair looks.

pokedexEntries.as: It carefully carries a round, white rock that it thinks is an egg. It’s bothered by how curly its hair looks.

pokedexEntries.su: It carries a round white rock in its belly pouch. If it gets along well with someone, it will sometimes give that person the rock.

pokedexEntries.mo: It’s too small to lay eggs yet. As a surrogate, it searches out round white stones.

pokedexEntries.us: Usually it’s a well-behaved Pokémon, but if you take its round rock away, it will cry and fuss and throw a big old tantrum.

pokedexEntries.um: When it sees something round and white, Happiny puts it into the pouch on its stomach. It sometimes becomes overloaded and can’t move.

pokedexEntries.sw: Mimicking Chansey, Happiny will place an egg- shaped stone in its belly pouch. Happiny will treasure this stone.

pokedexEntries.sh: Happiny’s willing to lend its precious round stone to those it’s friendly with, but if the stone isn’t returned, Happiny will cry and throw a tantrum.

pokedexEntries.bd: It loves round, white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of Chansey.

pokedexEntries.shp: It carries a round, egg-shaped rock in its belly pouch and gives the rock to its friends.

pokedexEntries.la: In imitation of Chansey, it keeps a round stone tucked into its belly pouch and cherishes it dearly. It gets along well with children and will sometimes play house with them for fun.

pokedexEntries.sc: It carries a round, white rock in its belly pouch. If it gets along well with someone, it will sometimes give that person the rock.

pokedexEntries.vi: It carefully carries a round, white rock that it thinks is an egg. It's bothered by how curly its hair looks.
